   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      4 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 15 jun 2026 - 13 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Gumball Kara_, 4 jul 2026, 1/5: "The app keeps crashing without any warnings. I’ve uninstalled, installed and updated the app but I am still unable to open it on my iPhone 11."
            2. _Oyyun_, 6 jul 2026, 3/5: "I used to use this all the time but now I can't even open the app. I've even tried uninstalling and reinstalling, but it still crashes on open. Back to using Apple Reminders I guess"
            3. _DubV23_, 13 ago 2026, 4/5: "Good tasks lists with no frills but a buggy widget that list the color code with the list title. I wish the widget could be made one size larger and that widget would allow you to see just the scheduled tasks despite which list they are in."
